fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M6JYZ5 (Constraint). No owner present. The planner found internal/machine (Path, Read, Load) is the only code that builds the machine.toml path and its three callers (machine.show, health, the session bypass check) only read it; machine-show's acceptance checks describe --json lists no writing op. Only capabilities are build leaves, so the plan records a constraint 'Rhiza never writes or raises a machine's trust' plus one capability leaf under runtime that builds its check. The planner asked which check proves no op writes machine.toml (behavioural run-every-op, static package guard, or both). The arbiter decided machine-trust-unwritten-check: both a go/parser source scan (internal/machine calls no file-writing function, exports only Path/Read/Load/Config and trust constants, nothing outside it joins or opens machine.toml) and a testscript running machine show, api call machine.show, health and a refused bypass session start against a daily machine.toml, which stays byte-identical, and with no config, which stays absent. The change set serves milestone-25, relates to and replaces draft 01M6GXMVKD6C14, which is withdrawn.
fields.title: Constraint plan interview (machine trust never written)
